text:
Maya Patel: quick sync — we need to prioritize which SKUs to push to cloud marketplaces next month. H100 and Gaudi registers look promising but vendors flagged firmware and image readiness.
Rajiv Singh: +1. Can we map priority to embargo windows? if H100 slips, we should promote H200/B200 fallback in the announcement cadence.
Olivia Chen: vendors gave a soft ETA: H100 CI images by 04/18, Gaudi by 04/22, MI300 still TBD (driver stability). firmware v2.1 for H100 has a regression though.
Tom Brooks: regression details? is it perf or correctness?
Olivia Chen: perf under tail latency — kernel hotpath with >2048 token sequences. vendor engineering is investigating. reproducer attached in the ticket.
PartnerBot: Vendor update posted: https://partners.example.com/notes/PRJ-4567 — H100 fw v2.1 candidate delayed ~5 days. Reaction :warning:
Maya Patel: ok — propose this temporary plan:
- Marketplace wave A (04/25): Gaudi (stable images), B200 (reserve), H200 (announce readiness)
- Wave B (05/02): H100 (if fw fix confirmed) + MI300 pilot if driver ok
Can we get a thumbs on that?
Rajiv Singh: prefer flipping H200 and B200 roles — H200 provides closer perf parity with H100 for most workloads.
Tom Brooks: agree with Rajiv. H200 as main fallback. B200 as low-tier offering.
Olivia Chen: noted. I can update marketplace listings and SI onboarding docs.
Maya Patel: also need to lock embargo windows with press & partners. If H100 slips past 05/02 we should hold the joint announcement and instead do a staggered comms plan.
Rajiv Singh: action: @Olivia to confirm image tags and canary schedule. @Tom to run a smoke matrix for H200 fallback paths.
Olivia Chen: working on it. sample canary manifest:
```
image: registry.redwood.ai/gaudi:2024-04-18-canary
tests:
  - latency_smoke
  - kv_cache_integrity
  - kv_cache_warmup
```
Tom Brooks: I'll kick off smoke runs on staging1 and staging2 tomorrow morning. Will post logs here.
QA Team Bot: Canary run queued: job 8842; will report status when complete.
PartnerBot: FYI — SI partners requested a 48h heads-up before marketplace promote. Also asked about SDK changes for H200 memory layout.
Maya Patel: good point. Olivia — can you prepare a 2-day pre-promote brief for partners (bullet list of known regressions, recommended fallbacks, test artifacts, contact matrix)?
Olivia Chen: yes. ETA EOD today.
Rajiv Singh: don't forget to include rollback criteria (e.g., 99.9th latency > 2x baseline) and fallback routing policy example config.
Maya Patel: routing policy example shortform:
- primary: h100:tag=2024-05-02
- fallback: h200:latest
- degrade-to: b200:economy
- region-fallback: eu-west->us-west
Tom Brooks: will add a small playbook for SI: how to patch client libs for memory layout differences (+ sample diff).
Olivia Chen: partner brief draft uploaded: https://docs.redwood.ai/partnerships/pre-promote-brief-0424 — comments welcome.
Rajiv Singh: quick risk note: MI300 driver hangs seen in heavy-compile workloads. we should keep MI300 as "experimental" in marketplace until next driver.
Maya Patel: agreed. MI300 = pilot tag, not GA.
Tom Brooks: timeline check — if firmware for H100 fixes in 5 days, can we still make the 05/02 wave and keep embargo? we need final signoff by 04/29.
Olivia Chen: vendor says tentative signoff by 04/27 if their tests pass. so 04/29 is tight but feasible.
Maya Patel: decision flow then:
- 04/27: vendor final signoff
- 04/28: Redwood canaries green
- 04/29 noon: stakeholder signoff (partners, comms, legal)
- 05/02: marketplace promote (if signed off)
Rajiv Singh: sounds good. If any step fails, we hold announce and do a partner-only heads-up instead.
Maya Patel: last ask — @Tom can you prepare a short contingency note (2 bullets) for the press team outlining reasons for a delay (technical regression vs supply)?
Tom Brooks: will do. draft in ~2h.
Olivia Chen: uploaded updated listing drafts and SI onboarding checklist. tagging @Rajiv for the routing policy example.
QA Team Bot: Canary job 8842 finished: 3/3 tests passed on gaudi canary, H200 smoke queued 1/4 passed so far.
Maya Patel: thanks everyone. follow-ups: Olivia (partner brief), Tom (smoke + contingency note), Rajiv (routing policy review). I'll loop in Comms once we hit 04/27 signoff.
Rajiv Singh: ack.
Olivia Chen: ack.
Tom Brooks: ack.
PartnerBot: Reminder scheduled: 04/27 09:00 vendor final signoff meeting. :calendar:
Maya Patel: meeting added. closing thread for now, will reopen if vendor changes ETA.
